subtitle: An advanced climate integration for Home Assistant that works with any existing thermostat entity
easy-install-explain: Versatile Thermostat installs in one click via HACS (Home Assistant Community Store). Everything is then configured in the interface, without YAML, with many options to fit every setup: your first thermostat is ready in minutes.
why-explain: Versatile Thermostat was designed to overcome the limitations of standard thermostats in Home Assistant. Our goal is to provide you with intelligent and efficient climate regulation that adapts to your specific needs.

cta.title: Ready to improve your heating system?
cta.desc: Join thousands of users who have already optimized their comfort and energy consumption

tpi.title: Self-learning TPI regulation
tpi.desc: The TPI algorithm doses heating at each cycle based on the gap to the setpoint and the outdoor temperature. Auto-TPI learns each room's coefficients, and valves can be driven directly by opening.

window.title: Open windows, even without a sensor
window.desc: Heating stops when a window opens, detected by a sensor or by a sudden temperature drop, and resumes when it closes.

presence.title: Automatic presence and motion
presence.desc: Switches to away mode when the house is empty and back to comfort as soon as motion is detected: no automation to write.

power.title: Power shedding
power.desc: Electric radiators are switched off by priority so you never exceed your contracted power.

central.title: Central boiler and central mode
central.desc: The boiler starts as soon as a room calls for heat and stops when none does. A single selector switches every thermostat to eco, frost protection or off.

safety.title: Safety and failure detection
safety.desc: If the sensor stops responding, safety mode prevents overheating or letting the room freeze. An alert flags heating that does not heat.

heating.title: What is your heating system?
heating.desc: Pick your heating type: Versatile Thermostat strengths and a step-by-step tutorial.

trv.title: Thermostatic valve
trv.desc: Zigbee thermostatic heads on hot-water radiators.

pilot_wire.title: Electric pilot wire
pilot_wire.desc: Electric radiators driven by pilot wire or relay.

heat_pump.title: Heat pump
heat_pump.desc: Air-to-air heat pump or reversible AC controlled by Home Assistant.

pellet_stove.title: Pellet stove
pellet_stove.desc: Stove driven by dry contact, relay or a dedicated integration.

main-features-desc: What sets Versatile Thermostat apart from other Home Assistant thermostats.

tools.title: Community tools
tools.desc: To diagnose and extend your regulation.

debugger.title: Log analyzer
debugger.desc: Load your logs and see temperatures, setpoints and triggers on a chart. Everything stays in your browser.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.desc: Regulation algorithms, cards, blueprints and integrations, official or from the community.

press.title: They talk about Versatile Thermostat
press.desc: Articles, videos and podcasts from the community and the press.
